source_training: All and only observed admitted source rows after fixed genotype exclusions; no target labels or donor phenotypes
source_evaluation_prerequisite: Complete nine-block matched source evaluation for the same panel; require execution/coverage validity, not a favorable screen. Negative source performance cannot select new settings or prevent the prespecified native diagnostic.
group_validation: Measured original host and reference:T7/T3 groups from the same bound grouping reports; both-unseen plus publication holdout
settings: Bound source design fixed settings and per-scope feature cap; no source-CV or native performance tuning
inference_boundary: All three source-only bundle manifests frozen before native scoring; complete six-pair matrices saved before separate native-label evaluation
label_access: Fitter does not parse Ando cases or historical WIsH scores. Source labels are selected only for admitted training Sample rows.
failure: Preserve partial artifacts and failed-attempt receipt; no automatic retry or source/parameter repair
interpretation: Whole-proteome association scores, uncalibrated; no binding, receptor causality, assembly, design or orderable DNA capability
prospective_attribution_interpretation: Paired concordance above a separately fitted host-only model is an ablation-screen difference, not proof that the paired model learned phage-conditional host ordering. Existing source screen keys and thresholds remain unchanged for compatibility; inspect within-model query variation and representation limits separately.
revision_reason: Technical identity-reporting repair after preserved v1 copied-proteome failure and fixed-context mode probes; frozen before any interaction-model fitting, without phenotype/native outcomes.
identity_semantics: Only the two SEARCH commands request --alignment-mode 3: aligned-residue sequence identity is computed for their --min-seq-id 0.4 criterion and downstream hit ranking, under unchanged seq-id/coverage defaults. Clustering retains its original --min-seq-id 0.4 score-based estimated-similarity parameter/default behavior; this is not an assertion of exact-identity clustering or exhaustive homology detection.
